description_extension.message: Warns you when a site imitates a bank protected by Codebyr OS.

ressemble.message: This site ($HOTE$) looks like your bank's site ($BANQUE$) but it is not the official one.

deguise.message: Its address imitates ordinary letters with characters from another alphabet, or accented ones: behind its appearance, it is spelled “$HOTE$”.

jamais.message: Never enter your credentials here. For your bank, use the Codebyr OS Bank Space.

legitime.message: This site is legitimate, don't warn me again
